profile_endpoint: profile an endpoint with cProfile sampling to save performance stats to endpoint_profile.pstat
wrap_function_with_line_profiler: wrap a module function with line_profiler for line-by-line performance analysis
wrap_function_directly: wrap a callable function directly with line_profiler for detailed profiling
collect_line_profiler_stats: collect and save line_profiler statistics to a file or print to stdout
register_shutdown_handler: register an atexit handler to automatically save line_profiler stats on process exit
